ios.desc:
Chat & Roleplay with AI - Offline, Anytime!

Talk with custom AI characters without needing an internet connection or Wifi. Enjoy 100% free and private interactions, whether you're roleplaying with your favorite characters or using the AI as a personal assistant.

Key Features:
- Offline Mode: Download the AI model once and chat anytime, anywhere—no WiFi needed.
- Uncensored Conversations: Engage in unrestricted dialogue for the most immersive experience.
- Custom AI Models: Optimized for roleplay, speed, and quality, offering tailored interactions.

Device Requirements:
- Minimum: iPhone 13. Will have slower chat response speed.
- Recommended: iPhone 15 or newer for the best performance.

quotes.text:
My friend and I were frustrated by the censorship, lack of privacy, and lack of control in current chat platforms. We saw all the great tools for running LLMs locally like SillyTavern. We realized it'd be awesome to make a great mobile roleplay experience w/ local LLMs.

So we made an offline role play app that's:

- 100% free
- Completely private (no servers are used. all the data stays on your phone)
- Runs offline LLMs (we finetuned Gemma 2B). No internet needed.
- Let’s you create and own your characters

Here are the links to download it and our Discord:

Appstore link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/yap-ai/id6633414696

Discord invite: https://discord.com/invite/CVKQa5mpnS

Quick note: It's currently only available on iPhone 13 and up (with even faster performance on iPhone 15+). We are working to make this available on more devices.

We would really appreciate your feedback and thoughts. We hope you enjoy using it like we do :). Next we are thinking about working on:

1. Writing style options
2. Image generation capabilities
3. Overall speed improvements
quotes.story_title: Chat with characters on your phone. Offline, private, and free
